About the author

Cal Newport is a professor of computer science at Georgetown University who studies human flourishing in a technological world. He is the author of numerous bestselling books, including Slow Productivity, A World Without Email, Digital Minimalism, and Deep Work, which have collectively sold over 3 million copies in over 50 languages. He is also a frequent contributor to The New Yorker and The New York Times and is the host of a weekly podcast.
